title: runs/<run_id>/skill-doctor/fixes-<build>/fixes.json (nightly-fix emit; contract v1, partial)
description: The Fix stage's outcome per candidate, the skipped rows, and pr_checks: the replay check of the open PR each row's diagnosis names as its fix (fixed_by_pr). Only the keys below are pinned; candidates carry more fields (gates, patch lines).

max_prs.description: the cap on PRs OPENED by this run (rank order); not a selection cut

history_runs.description: the earlier nights the memory read (newest first)

outcome.description: pr-ready, needs-live-run, needs-windows-run (a deciding criterion runs Windows-only tooling on a windows-tagged task), held-overlap, body-lint-failed, no-budget (not tried: the run's spend cap was used up; it rolls to the next night), ...

rank.description: select's order: rows covered, confidence, pr-ready on an earlier night, stable diagnosis, task id

reused_from.description: present when the patch of an earlier night was reused (rebased, model-free gates passed; no session, $0)

memory_note.description: what the earlier nights said about this candidate

inputs.description: git blob id per input file at the base (task yaml, its check files, the skill files the diagnosis names)

contested.description: the workflow's collision list ("#N open (author)", "<sha> merged <date> (author)", "contested by #N")

session_cap_usd.description: the cap the candidate's session started with

diagnosis_flip.description: {night, from, to}: the layer/solvable changed since the previous night

skip_reason.description: a memory skip ($0): a doctor PR with the fix is still open, or an earlier night rejected the fix and its inputs are unchanged

record.description: the earlier night's fixes.json candidate a memory decision used: runs/<run_id>/skill-doctor/<fixes_dir>/

head_sha.description: the PR head the check applied (refs/pull/<n>/head as fetched)

reason.description: why an untested check could not be replayed, when the board should say so
